component.name: Glassgram
component.summary: Telegram client with a liquid glass interface

description.p: An unofficial desktop Telegram client written in Rust. The layout follows Telegram Desktop; panels, menus and the composer are drawn as translucent glass.
Неофіційний десктопний клієнт Telegram на Rust. Структура — як у Telegram Desktop, панелі, меню й поле вводу — напівпрозоре скло.
Glassgram is not affiliated with Telegram FZ-LLC.
Bugfix: pinned chats and folders open on click again instead of being dragged, and their context menus work. The Windows executable carries a manifest and full version information.

Security hardening: safe links, safe file names, asking before hidden links and received programs. Saved Messages by source, search filters by type and sender, days with media in the calendar, stories, gifts and personal channels in profiles, emoji suggestions, reporting messages, opening chats at the first unread message, a send queue without duplicates, a memory budget for pictures. Large internal refactor.

Mini apps, sponsored messages, notifications for chats, contacts, translation, jump to date, polls and quizzes, privacy exceptions, group and channel editing, birthdays, bot start links, similar channels.
Windows installer and Flatpak, PipeWire microphone, Lucide icons, localisation files.
